```yaml
name: Stale Issue/PR Automation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 1 * * *' # Daily at 1:00 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run stale bot
        uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          days-before-stale: 90
          days-before-issue-stale: 90
          days-before-pr-stale: 90
          days-before-close: 150
          days-before-issue-close: 150
          days-before-pr-close: 150
          stale-issue-label: "stale"
          close-issue-label: "closed"
          exempt-issue-labels: "lifecycle/frozen,help-wanted,good-first-issue,pinned"
          exempt-assignees: "*"
          stale-issue-message: "This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had any activity in over 90 days. If you think this issue is still relevant, please leave a comment below explaining why. This helps us prioritize which issues to address."
          close-issue-message: "This issue was automatically closed because it has not had any activity in over 150 days. If you think this issue is still relevant, please reopen it and explain why. This helps us prioritize which issues to address."
          stale-pr-message: "This pull request has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had any activity in over 90 days. If you think this pull request is still relevant, please leave a comment below explaining why. This helps us prioritize which pull requests to review."
          close-pr-message: "This pull request was automatically closed because it has not had any activity in over 150 days. If you think this pull request is still relevant, please reopen it and explain why. This helps us prioritize which pull requests to review."
```
